messages.content: Answer in one short sentence.
What is the capital of Japan?
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.
Answer in one short sentence.
How many continents are there?
There are seven continents.
At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.
What is the largest ocean on Earth?
The Pacific is the largest ocean on Earth.
How many bones are in the adult human body?
An adult human body has 206 bones.
What gas do plants absorb from the air?
Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
What is the chemical symbol for iron?
The chemical symbol for iron is Fe.
Which river is the longest in Africa?
The Nile is the longest river in Africa.
How many sides does a hexagon have?
A hexagon has six sides.
What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
Light travels at about 300,000 kilometres per second in a vacuum.
Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Mercury is liquid at room temperature.
What is the smallest prime number?
Two is the smallest prime number.
How long does the Earth take to orbit the Sun?
The Earth takes about 365 days to orbit the Sun.
What is the hardest natural substance?
Diamond is the hardest natural substance.
Which organ pumps blood through the body?
The heart pumps blood through the body.
What is the main gas in the Earth's atmosphere?
Nitrogen is the main gas in the Earth's atmosphere.
How many degrees are in a right angle?
A right angle has 90 degrees.
Which country has the largest population?
India has the largest population.
What is the freezing point of water in Fahrenheit?
Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
What does DNA stand for?
DNA stands for deoxyribonucleic acid.
Which mountain is the tallest above sea level?
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level.
How many players are on a football team on the pitch?
A football team fields eleven players.
What is the currency of the United Kingdom?
The currency of the United Kingdom is the pound sterling.
